**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/14 (Tue) 14:30  
[CHANGE] User has been making an effort to cut down on social media lately.  
[EVENT] User took a week-long break from social media in mid-January 2023.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in tracking screen time and social media usage.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested several screen time tracking apps: Screen Time (iOS), Digital Wellbeing (Android), Moment (iOS, Android), Freedom (iOS, Android), StayFocused (Chrome extension).  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested social media tracking and management tools: RescueTime (Web, iOS, Android), Hootsuite Insights (Web), Cold Turkey (Web, iOS, Android), SelfControl (Mac), StayAway (iOS).  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended other tools like website blockers (uBlock Origin, AdBlock, News Feed Eradicator) and phone features (Do Not Disturb mode, App Timer, Screen Time tracking).  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in trying out the Moment and Freedom apps.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided detailed information about Moment's features, including screen time tracking, app tracking, goal setting, phone-free mode, family mode, insights, and the coach feature.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided detailed information about Freedom's features, including app blocking, website blocking, customizable blocking, scheduling, lockdown mode, syncing, focus mode, and stats.  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in Moment's app tracking feature.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained how Moment tracks apps, including app usage time, frequency, duration, time of day, day of the week, top apps, and app categories.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided tips on how to use Moment's app tracking data to make changes to phone habits, including identifying time-wasting apps, setting app-specific goals, scheduling app usage, replacing bad habits, finding alternative apps, setting screen-free times, and reflecting and adjusting.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a step-by-step guide on how to set a daily time limit for social media in Moment, including opening the app, selecting social media, setting a goal, choosing a daily time limit, scheduling the goal, and saving the goal.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained how Moment enforces the goal by tracking usage, sending alerts, and blocking access to apps when limits are reached.  
[PREFERENCE] User expressed interest in setting app-specific goals and scheduling app usage in Moment.
